title: MCP server
description: JSON Schema for an mcp instance: a long-running server speaking the Model Context Protocol that exposes a bound character's skills:G generator set as tools.

bound-to.description: Character slug the MCP server is bound to.

exposes-skill.description: Slugs of skills exposed as tools (the character's skills:G generator set).

mcp-config-path.description: Path to the .mcp.json config the server was launched from.
